interface_record_model.inheritance: An omitted field inherits the value below; null means the owner must confirm it before ROS-backed rollout.

defaults.qos: not applicable for service; owner confirmation required for an omitted topic QoS
defaults.success_terminal: owner-defined state described by the interface-specific semantics

resolved_conflicts.decision: /start_navigation is authoritative; /path_plan and phi_robot_interfaces/PathPlan are deprecated
Humble is authoritative; run_ros_acceptance.sh no longer sources Jazzy
application consumes /odom; the ZMQ boundary maps hardware /Odometry to /odom
request_id equals the dispatcher idempotency key; authoritative configured body frame is pelvis
robot_interfaces/ExecuteTrajectory response contains bool success and string message

interfaces.name: /start_navigation

request.trajectory_json: JSON string with target_x[m], target_y[m], yaw[rad], walk[bool]

interfaces.idempotency: not guaranteed by service; protected by dispatcher invocation
interfaces.success_terminal: service accepted/completed its bridge contract; not robot arrival

interfaces.name: /nav_reached
interfaces.success_terminal: fresh true after the current navigation goal; position <0.35m, yaw <10deg, stable 1.5s

interfaces.name: /nav_pause
interfaces.semantics: true requests pause; false requests resume
interfaces.success_terminal: no acknowledgement exists in Phase 1; publish is not confirmed stop

interfaces.name: /odom
interfaces.frame: message header/child frame from hardware bridge
interfaces.success_terminal: latest cache only; not an action completion signal

interfaces.name: /foundationpose/select_target
interfaces.idempotency: select=false is cleanup-idempotent; select=true starts a new observation epoch
interfaces.success_terminal: success=true and matched_object_id>=0 for target selection
interfaces.snapshot_status: owner version/hash must be confirmed before ROS skills/HIL

interfaces.name: /foundationpose/pose_results
interfaces.match_rule: sample received after current selection epoch, object_id matches selected target, state>=1
interfaces.snapshot_status: owner version/hash must be confirmed before ROS skills/HIL

interfaces.name: /submit_carry_task
interfaces.idempotency: reusing an accepted request_id must not start a second motion
interfaces.success_terminal: accepted=true only means accepted; HOLDING/ready verification is still required

interfaces.name: /notify_goal_reached
interfaces.idempotency: repeated notification in terminal carry state must be safe
interfaces.success_terminal: gateway reports success or already goal_reached_locked

interfaces.name: /set_lay_down
interfaces.success_terminal: service success, followed by replay/release verification

interfaces.name: /set_stand
interfaces.idempotency: standing terminal state may be treated as already complete
interfaces.success_terminal: posture_state is stand and gateway ready

interfaces.name: /request_replay
interfaces.idempotency: already active/finished is a successful terminal response

interfaces.qos: service default reliable; state topic depth 10 reliable
interfaces.idempotency: setting the same boolean source is idempotent; no implicit retry

interfaces.semantics: status true means object present; false means dropped

hil_blockers: Confirm the external FoundationPose service/message repository commit and int32 object ID fields
Confirm Gateway CARRY_TARGET_FRAME=pelvis and FP publishes actual transformed pelvis poses
Confirm /start_navigation bridge deployment uses the updated ExecuteTrajectory response
